facts.fact: GPE KIX says Eswatini's fully digital, PIN-driven EMIS, nationally launched in March 2024, covers all 976 primary and secondary schools and provides aggregate enrolment numbers.
GPE KIX says Eswatini's PIN-driven EMIS introduced individual-level student and staff tracking across all 976 schools.
